summary: Compressed discussion signals: multiple vendor security incidents (Anthropic/OpenAI), model launches (Grok/DeepSeek/Gemini Spark), operator pain with memory/MCP, and tooling for running agents. | Vendor releases and infra updates: Anthropic Opus 5 launch, GA evaluation tooling from Google, Mistral Studio/Vibe, Vercel AI Gateway and MCP updates, plus multiple sandbox/containment infra posts from Modal, Daytona, Cloudflare. | GitHub OSS snapshot: dominant vendor repos and infra primitives for agent stacks — OpenAI agents, large OSS platforms (Dify), memory & observability releases, plus security/sandbox primitives. Missing social/operator reports for real-world workflows. | Package-layer snapshot: many new agent SDKs, observability/eval tooling, and detector/agent runtimes—heavy on infra primitives; few social/operator reports to validate adoption.
